headline: Watch Valve set up the Steam Frame in its own leaked videos
summary: Valve accidentally leaked videos showing the Steam Frame VR headset. The footage included unboxing, setup, and various accessories. The videos appeared on the ARM Steam client before being quickly pulled.

headline: The wearable future is stuck in weird, experimental, existential limbo
summary: A weekly newsletter, Optimizer, explores the current state of wearable technology. The author tested the Google Pixel Watch 5, noting its typical modern features. The article discusses the experimental and uncertain future of wearables.

headline: Grab an iPad Air M4 for its lowest price since the June increase
summary: The 11-inch iPad Air with the M4 chip is currently on sale. It's available for $649, which is $100 below its new retail price. The deal can be found at Amazon and Best Buy.

headline: OpenAI hit the brakes. Now what?
summary: OpenAI has paused some AI development to tighten security and safeguards. This decision comes despite intense competition and an upcoming IPO. The company aims to prioritize responsible AI advancements.

headline: Relive the Original Xbox By Building Your Own 1:1 Scale 3,509-Piece Mattel Brick Shop Version
summary: Mattel is releasing a 1:1 scale, 3,509-piece buildable original Xbox model. Celebrating the Xbox's 25th anniversary, it includes a matching Duke controller. The model features lights, sounds, and scenes from classic Xbox games.

headline: Today’s Best Deals: Rise of Ronin, Beats Studio Pro Headphones, and 480Hz LG 480Hz OLED Gaming Monitor
summary: Today's top deals include Rise of Ronin and Beats Studio Pro Headphones. Also featured is a 480Hz LG OLED Gaming Monitor. Other offers cover Marvel Wolverine DualSense preorders and discounted luggage sets.

headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Beta Will Fix Issues That Have Plagued the Series for the Better Part of a Decade
summary: The upcoming Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta aims to address long-standing issues. These problems have affected the series for nearly a decade. The beta focuses on implementing crucial fixes for gameplay improvements.

headline: Latest Xbox Console Updates Include Extremely Belated Profile Badge if You Bought an Xbox One Back in 2013
summary: New Xbox console updates introduce a special profile badge. This badge is for users who purchased an Xbox One on its launch day in 2013. It's a belated recognition for early adopters of the console.

headline: Track defect found on approach to site of Lewes derailment, initial report says
summary: An initial RAIB investigation revealed an "irregularity" at the Lewes derailment site. A track defect was discovered on the approach to the incident location. Further details are expected as the report progresses.

headline: Thunderstorm warnings issued for parts of UK with flash flooding expected
summary: Thunderstorm warnings have been issued for several parts of the UK. Areas affected include northern England, eastern Scotland, and Northern Ireland. Flash flooding is anticipated to occur later on Wednesday.

headline: Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation
summary: Israel has confirmed its soldiers fired at the car where five-year-old Hind Rajab was killed. The incident has led to a criminal investigation being opened. Hind initially survived the attack and pleaded for help before her body was recovered.

headline: Salmonella outbreak: What we know so far
summary: Hundreds of individuals have fallen ill due to a salmonella outbreak. The infections have been linked to imported eggs. Investigations are currently underway to understand the full scope of the outbreak.
